label:
Whey protein
hydrolysate
note: Partial hydrolysates are made to be less allergenic; extensive ones (over 90 % hydrolysed in patent wording) for babies with cow milk protein allergy. The price is bitterness.

about.text: Whey protein that enzymes have chopped into short peptides, so that it is easier to digest and less allergenic than the intact protein. It goes into infant formulas, medical foods and sports drinks.

steps.name: hydrolyse
steps.note: With a porcine trypsin and chymotrypsin mix (activity ratio 0.33-0.66 in a patent); other proteases are also used.

facts.v: Partial: 4-10 % (patent for a whey/casein mix); Tatua whey grades 7-37 %; extensive: over 90 % in patent wording
More hydrolysis means more bitterness (hydrophobic peptides) and weaker emulsifying
